entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely terrible cycling shoes I bought. This is unbelievable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into a return for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

The issue is they're destroying my feet! I've moved the cleats around a hundred times, followed all your guides, and all I get are horrible blisters after every single ride. They're completely useless to me.

That sounds incredibly painful and frustrating, I certainly understand. Just so I can direct this correctly, would you say it's a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a sizing and comfort preference issue?
I don't know and I don't care! They don't work! I want a refund, and I want it now. This is the worst product I've ever bought. Get me your manager, right now! I'm not dealing with you.

I understand your frustration and you'd like to speak with a manager, but I am fully authorized to handle returns and issue refunds. If you'll allow me, I can resolve this for you right now. I just need to pull up your account. Could I please have your order number?
Fine! The order number is VF88675309. You better resolve it, because if I don't see my money back I'll make sure every cycling blog on the internet knows how VeloFit sells junk and won't stand by it.
Thank you for that. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see your purchase of the Road Cycling Shoes was delivered 63 days ago.
And? Are you telling me I'm stuck with them? Is that it?!

Not at all, sir. According to our policy, your purchase is well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file as we speak.
Wait, so you're just... giving me a full refund? No questions asked?

That's correct. A full refund for the cycling shoes. The label is in your inbox now. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's fine then. Just make sure it goes through quickly.
I will personally ensure it's tracked on our end. Again, I do apologize that the shoes caused you blisters and didn't work out. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a better rest of your day.
